template: Create ONE landscape 1536×1024 editorial image CONTACT SHEET with EXACTLY four equally sized independent image panels in a precise 2×2 grid. The dividing lines are exactly at 50% of image width and height, with a narrow 12 pixel solid neutral gutter. Each quadrant is individually composed as a 3:2 landscape picture and must keep all its elements at least 35 pixels from the grid lines and edge. This sheet will be sliced mechanically into four standalone files, so nothing may cross a dividing line. Each quadrant should have its own complete scene and background. No text, letters, digits, watermarks, logos or measurements. TOP LEFT: compelling clean overall product portrait with contextual scene and whole object; TOP RIGHT: one or two enlarged real key parts, as macro closeup or honest evidence-based exploded feature; BOTTOM LEFT: premium product specification plate art with the object small on the LEFT, ample clean blank space to its RIGHT, delicate technical or grid backdrop, NO numbers, NO text, NO pretend measurements; BOTTOM RIGHT: three consistent alternate product angles (front, side, rear or 3/4), side by side in one neutral panel. Keep same exact variant and color in all panels. No unverified internals, interfaces or controls. Art direction:
